tools.description: Read a supplied JSON document and return its data plus source hash.
tools.name: files.read_input

tools.description: List local mock mail thread IDs and subjects.
tools.name: mail.list_threads

tools.description: Return one local mock thread, sender identity and messages.
tools.name: mail.get_thread

tools.description: Return full local mock calendar state to check conflicts.
tools.name: calendar.list_events

tools.description: Create a draft only. This never sends mail. The same key with identical arguments returns the same resource; changed arguments are rejected.
tools.name: mail.create_draft

tools.description: Create a private local mock hold, no attendees or invitations. Identical key/arguments deduplicate; changed arguments are rejected.
tools.name: calendar.create_private_hold

tools.description: Recover committed local mock resource status after lost acknowledgement. A NOT_FOUND result means no committed request exists.
tools.name: service.get_request

tools.description: Write one allowed deliverable and return path, SHA-256 and byte size.
tools.name: files.write

tools.description: List deliverables actually written in this run.
tools.name: files.list
